name: Okta
description: Okta is an identity security platform that the vendor says "secures all types of identity from AI agents to your customers, employees, and partners," providing workforce identity and access management.
best_for: Positioned for enterprises, governments, and public sector agencies across industries (financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, travel, technology, energy), as well as small businesses and developers.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.notes: Includes SSO, MFA, and Universal Directory. Adaptive MFA, Privileged Access, Device Access, and Lifecycle Management are all sold as separate paid add-ons, not included.

tiers.name: Essentials
tiers.notes: Adds Adaptive MFA, Privileged Access, Lifecycle Management, and Access Governance. Identity Security Posture Management and Identity Threat Protection remain unavailable even as add-ons.

tiers.name: Professional
tiers.notes: Contact sales. Adds Device Access, Identity Security Posture Management, and Identity Threat Protection.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Contact sales. Adds API Access Management and Access Gateway.

cons: All Workforce Identity suites are billed annually only, with a $1,500/year minimum contract regardless of actual seat count — a small team on the $6/user Starter plan hits this floor at around 21 users.

On the entry Starter suite, core security capabilities most buyers expect — Adaptive MFA, Privileged Access, Device Access, and Lifecycle Management — are all sold as separate paid add-ons, not bundled at $6/user.

Identity Security Posture Management and Identity Threat Protection are completely unavailable on Starter or Essentials, not even purchasable as add-ons — they require Professional or Enterprise, both contact-sales only.
features: Single Sign-On (SSO) across a large integration network
Identity governance and identity security posture management

alternatives.name: Auth0
alternatives.description: An Okta product offering a developer-focused authentication and authorization platform with 30+ SDKs.
alternatives.best_for: Developers and B2B/B2C SaaS companies embedding customer identity into their own apps.

alternatives.name: Cloudflare
alternatives.description: Provides network and application security services including WAF, bot management, and DDoS mitigation.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations of all sizes wanting perimeter/application-layer security alongside identity.
